title: Quantitative Theory for the Amplitude of Fluorescence Quantum Beats from Geminate Triplet-Pair Fusion
summary: We derive the amplitude of fluorescence quantum beats caused by geminate triplet-exciton fusion from the full set of parameters that characterize singlet fission and triplet exciton dynamics. We apply the theory to tetracene and rubrene single crystals. We find that the amplitude depends on the fission time in tetracene, but does not do so in rubrene, where it is determined by the dimensionality of triplet transport. Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations reproduce the experimental data in both materials, for a fission time of the order of 200 ps and isotropic triplet transport in tetracene, and for a triplet hopping time along the herringbone axis of 200-300 ps and anisotropic transport in rubrene.

AI.tldr: 该文从单线态裂分与三重态激子动力学的完整参数集出发，推导了孪生三重态激子聚变所致荧光量子拍振幅的理论表达式，并将其应用于并四苯与红荧烯单晶，结合动力学蒙特卡罗模拟解释了实验数据。
AI.motivation: 荧光量子拍是探测孪生三重态对（geminate triplet pair）及其聚变过程的有力手段，但量子拍振幅与单线态裂分时间、三重态输运维度等微观参数之间的定量关系尚不明晰，缺乏可同时拟合两类材料实验的系统理论。
AI.method: 建立解析理论：由单线态裂分与三重态激子动力学的全部参数（裂分时间、三重态跳跃时间、输运各向异性/维度等）推导孪生三重态聚变诱导的荧光量子拍振幅；将理论应用于并四苯与红荧烯单晶，并以动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）模拟对比实验数据。
AI.result: 并四苯中量子拍振幅依赖于裂分时间，而红荧烯中则不依赖，后者由三重态输运的维度决定。KMC模拟可同时再现两种材料的实验数据：并四苯对应约200 ps量级的裂分时间与各向同性三重态输运；红荧烯对应沿人字形（herringbone）轴200–300 ps的三重态跳跃时间与各向异性输运。
AI.conclusion: 荧光量子拍振幅可作为区分裂分动力学与三重态输运机制的定量探针；并四苯与红荧烯中量子拍振幅对裂分时间依赖性的差异，源于二者三重态输运维度与各向异性的不同。

title: Quantum vacuum inversion and multi-kink unbinding in the non-degenerate double sine-Gordon model
summary: Quantum fluctuations can unbind a composite soliton while the correction to its mass stays small. We show this beyond perturbation theory for the multi-kinks of the non-degenerate double sine-Gordon model. At one loop the vacuum at the centre of the multi-kink becomes the true vacuum at a coupling of order the classical lifting of the vacua. Tensor-network calculations of the lattice theory show that this inversion survives beyond one loop and has a continuum limit, and that the Gaussian effective potential captures it. On finite chains the multi-kink unbinds when the tension of the string of central vacuum between its two halves falls through zero

AI.tldr: 量子涨落可使复合孤子解绑，而对其质量的修正仍保持很小；作者在非简并双sine-Gordon模型的多扭结中超越微扰论证明了这一点。
AI.motivation: 此前对孤子的量子修正多以微扰论处理，通常认为质量修正小则孤子稳定。本文检验"小质量修正即稳定"这一直觉是否成立，考察量子涨落能否使复合（多）孤子解绑。
AI.method: 以非简并双sine-Gordon模型的多扭结为对象：单圈有效势分析（比较多扭结中心处真空与真实真空）；并采用格点理论的张量网络数值计算，检验单圈结论在非微扰层面是否成立、是否存在连续极限；同时检验高斯有效势能否捕捉该现象；在有限链上分析中心真空"弦"的张力。
AI.result: 单圈下，多扭结中心真空在耦合量级约为真空经典抬升时成为真正真空；张量网络计算表明这一反转超越单圈依然存在并具有连续极限，高斯有效势能正确捕捉该效应；有限链上，当两半之间中心真空弦的张力降至零时，多扭结解绑。
AI.conclusion: 复合孤子的解绑与质量修正大小之间无必然联系：即使质量修正很小，量子涨落仍可导致解绑。该结论在非微扰格点计算中得到确认并具有连续极限，且高斯有效势足以描述，有限链上以中心真空弦张力过零作为解绑判据。

title: On pseudospectra of the relativistic rotated harmonic oscillator
summary: We establish an upper bound to the norm of the resolvent of a relativistic version of the non-self-adjoint operator obtained by a dilation analytic transformation of the quantum harmonic oscillator. The estimate implies a decay for large complex energies along rays with angles larger than that of the dilation. In this way we positively answer a question left open in [Proceedings of the Royal Society A 2025].

AI.tldr: 对相对论型非自伴伸缩解析算子的预解式范数给出上界，证明大复能量沿大于伸缩角的射线方向衰减，正面回答了Proc. Roy. Soc. A (2025)中的公开问题。
AI.motivation: 此前工作（Proc. Roy. Soc. A 2025）遗留了一个关于相对论型非自伴算子预解式在复能量渐近行为上的未解问题，本文旨在予以解决。
AI.method: 对量子谐振子作伸缩解析变换所得非自伴算子的相对论版本，建立其预解式范数的上界估计。
AI.result: 所得估计蕴含预解式在大复能量下沿与伸缩角相比较大的射线方向呈衰减。
AI.conclusion: 该上界正面回答了文献中遗留的公开问题。

title: On the richness of metamaterials generated by recursive cell division
summary: Scale-rich metamaterials are one member of a family of recursive cell divisions, which differ in which cell is cut, where the cut passes and at what angle. We characterise six members of this family through three network mappings, the cell tree, the dual graph of ligaments and junctions, and the frame graph of spans, and through their elastic-wave properties: the effective refractive index n, its isotropy and the band over which it holds. The dual-graph degree law, the mean degree and the age law of the ligaments hit by new ones are the same for every rule, so they cannot distinguish the materials. The cell tree and the cell shapes do differ, and one consequence of them explains the physics: the tail of long spans in the frame graph. With the longest spans as the length scale, the bending part of the inverse squared index follows a single power law across rules, densities and numbers of ligaments, and the same spans set the lowest local resonance and the band edge. The stretching part, which caps the index, is carried by the straight frame lines of the tiling rather than by the division. Random cut angles produce elongated cells and long spans, hence high index and a narrow band; cuts perpendicular to the long axis of the cell keep the cells compact, giving low index and a wide band. Cutting through the centroid instead of a random point bounds the split fraction between 4/9 and 5/9, which removes the area hierarchy without changing the index. The cut angle interpolates continuously between these limits, and the isotropy peaks where the ligament orientations become isotropic while the cells are still compact. In three dimensions the plate and strut divisions are stretching dominated and the index stays low for every rule.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由递归胞元分割生成的一类超材料（"尺度丰富超材料"），通过三种网络映射与弹性波性质刻画其中六个成员，揭示长跨段分布是决定折射率与带宽的统一机制。
AI.motivation: 递归胞元分割家族包含多种几何规则（被切胞元、切点位置、切角不同），但此前不清楚哪些几何特征真正决定其弹性波性质，哪些特征在同族材料间是普适的、因而无法区分材料。
AI.method: 采用三种网络映射刻画材料：胞元树、由韧带与节点构成的对偶图、由跨段构成的框架图；并计算弹性波性质——有效折射率 n、其各向同性程度及该性质成立的频带。将几何量与 n 的弯曲部分、拉伸部分、最低局域共振与带边联系起来，并考察二维中切点为质心与随机点、切角连续变化的影响，最后推广到三维的板型与杆型分割。
AI.result: 对偶图的度律、平均度与"新旧韧带碰撞的年龄律"在所有分割规则下相同，故不能区分材料；胞元树与胞元形状确有差异，其物理后果体现为框架图中长跨段的尾部。以最长跨段为长度尺度，逆折射率平方的弯曲部分在所有规则、密度和韧带数下遵循单一幂律；同样的长跨段决定最低局域共振与带边。拉伸部分（对折射率起上限作用）由平铺的直线框架线承担，而非由分割方式决定。随机切角产生拉长胞元与长跨段，导致高折射率与窄带；垂直长轴切割保持胞元紧凑，得到低折射率与宽带。过质心切割将分割比限制在 4/9 至 5/9，消除面积层级但不改变折射率。切角在两极限间连续插值，各向同性在韧带取向趋于各向同性而胞元仍紧凑时达到峰值。三维中板型与杆型分割以拉伸主导，各规则下折射率均较低。
AI.conclusion: 区分该递归分割家族材料的关键不在对偶图的普适统计量，而在胞元树与胞元形状所导致的框架图长跨段分布；长跨段作为统一长度尺度同时支配折射率的弯曲标度、最低共振与带边，而直线框架线决定拉伸上限。因此通过切点与切角的几何调控即可在折射率、带宽与各向同性之间进行设计取舍。

title: Exact solution of the two-dimensional one-component plasma on the truncated Beltrami pseudosphere
summary: The two-dimensional one-component plasma, $N$ logarithmically interacting point charges in a neutralizing background, is solved exactly at coupling $\Gamma=2$ on the truncated Beltrami pseudosphere, the tractrix-generated surface of constant curvature $-1/a^2$, bounded by its rim and by a second parallel at meridian parameter $u=u_{\max}$. A conformal map takes the surface onto a flat cylinder, where the interaction is the flat-cylinder potential and the curvature enters only through the area element; the partition function is a product of incomplete gamma functions, the density is explicit and all correlations are determinantal. The thermodynamic limit is taken at fixed background density, with $u_{\max}$ fixed and $a\propto\sqrt{N}$, as on the sphere; the logarithmic interaction having no intrinsic length, this is equivalent to letting $N$ grow on a fixed surface. The free energy is obtained through the constant term, all coefficients in closed form: a bulk term proportional to $N$, the flat hard-wall surface tension times the total boundary length, and a shape-dependent constant, with no term in $\ln N$. This is the conformal-anomaly prediction for Euler characteristic zero, tested here with integrated Gaussian and boundary curvatures separately nonzero and cancelling; the model being a cylinder plasma with a specific axial potential, the expansion coincides term by term with the general result of Shen and Forrester, whose universal constants are the quadratures of the two boundary layers. At both walls the density tends to the flat contact value $n_b\ln 2$, from opposite sides, although their circumferences differ by a factor $\cosh u_{\max}$. Asymptotics are checked against the exact solution up to $N=4096$, and Monte Carlo simulations at $\Gamma=1$, 4 and 6, validated on the exact $\Gamma=2$ density, show how both boundary layers evolve with the coupling.

AI.tldr: 在截断Beltrami伪球面上精确求解Γ=2的二维单组分等离子体，得到闭式自由能与解析密度、行列式关联，并与Shen–Forrester普适结果及蒙特卡罗模拟对照。
AI.motivation: 负常曲率曲面上对数相互作用等离子体的精确可解性此前仅在球面等情形实现，需检验共形反常预测在Euler示性数为零、高斯曲率与边界曲率分别非零而相互抵消的几何上的有效性。
AI.method: 取截断Beltrami伪球面（曲率−1/a²，由rim与u=u_max平行圈围成），经共形映射化为平直圆柱；相互作用取平直圆柱势，曲率仅进入面积元。配分函数化为不完全伽马函数之积，密度显式给出、全部关联为行列式型。热力学极限取固定背景密度、u_max固定、a∝√N。
AI.result: 自由能由常数项给出且各系数闭式：正比于N的体项、平直硬壁表面张力乘总边界长度、与形状相关的常数项，无ln N项；与Shen–Forrester的一般展开逐项一致，其普适常数即两个边界层的积分。两壁处密度均趋于平直接触值n_b ln2但来自相反侧，尽管周长相差cosh u_max倍。渐近结果在N≤4096与精确解吻合；Γ=1,4,6的蒙特卡罗在精确Γ=2密度上校准，显示边界层随耦合的演化。
AI.conclusion: 该模型构成共形反常预测在χ=0几何上的精确检验，并为Shen–Forrester普适有限尺度展开提供逐项验证；边界层结构与耦合依赖由模拟给出定量刻画。

title: Statistical Properties of the $q$-Deformed Monolayer and Bilayer Graphene
summary: We investigate the statistical properties of the $q$-deformed Dirac oscillator for monolayer and bilayer graphene in the presence of a constant external magnetic field. Using $q$-deformed creation and annihilation operators, we obtain the corresponding energy spectra and eigenfunctions, as well as their probability current densities, recovering the conventional Landau-level structures in the undeformed limit. For bilayer graphene, the lowest Landau levels are explicitly constructed within the $q$-deformed framework. The partition functions for both systems are derived using zeta-function techniques and the Euler-Maclaurin formula, allowing us to determine their main thermodynamic quantities for small values of the deformation parameter. Our results show that the $q$-deformation modifies the energy spectra, the behavior of the probability current density components, and the thermodynamic response of the systems. A comparison between monolayer and bilayer graphene reveals distinct thermal behaviors, reflecting their different Landau-level structures and highlighting the influence of the $q$-deformation on their statistical properties.

AI.tldr: 利用q形变产生/湮灭算符求解单层与双层石墨烯中q形变Dirac振子的能谱、本征函数与概率流密度，并用zeta函数与Euler-Maclaurin公式导出配分函数及小形变参数下的热力学量。
AI.motivation: 考察q形变（非交换/量子群型修正）如何改变石墨烯中Dirac振子的朗道能级结构，并系统比较单层与双层体系的热统计响应。
AI.method: 在恒定外磁场下，用q形变产生与湮灭算符处理单层与双层石墨烯的Dirac振子；显式构造双层体系最低朗道能级；以zeta函数正则化结合Euler-Maclaurin公式计算配分函数，并在形变参数q的小量展开下求主要热力学量。
AI.result: 在未形变极限下可还原常规朗道能级结构；q形变修正了能谱、概率流密度各分量及热力学响应；单层与双层石墨烯呈现不同的热行为，源于二者朗道能级结构的差异。
AI.conclusion: q形变是调控石墨烯类体系朗道能级与统计/热力学性质的有效手段，单层与双层因能级结构不同而对形变表现出可区分的热响应。

title: Renormalization-Group Foundation of Critical Modes in Correlation Matrices
summary: Based on the relevant scaling operators of renormalization-group theory, we establish a theoretical framework for constructing complete families of critical-sensitive fluctuation observables and their connected correlation matrices. The corresponding eigenstates of the correlation matrices reveal a hierarchy of multiscale critical correlation patterns and the leading normalized eigenvalues and their ratios show the finite-size scaling behavior. Applying this framework to the two-dimensional Ising model, the correlation matrices associated with both spin and energy operators are constructed. The resulting energy-sector eigenstate patterns, together with the scaling behavior of the leading eigenvalues, provide further support for the proposed framework. Finally, we discuss its potential extension to systems with unknown Hamiltonians.

AI.tldr: 基于重整化群标度算符，构建临界敏感涨落观测量及其连通关联矩阵的完整族构造框架，并在二维Ising模型中验证。
AI.motivation: 为系统化刻画临界点附近多尺度涨落与关联结构，需要一个由重整化群标度算符出发、可生成完整关联矩阵族的理论框架。
AI.method: 以重整化群理论的标度算符为基础，构造临界敏感涨落观测量族及连通关联矩阵；对关联矩阵作本征分解，提取多尺度临界关联模式层级，并分析领头归一化本征值及其比值的有限尺寸标度行为；在二维Ising模型中分别针对自旋算符与能量算符构造关联矩阵。
AI.result: 二维Ising模型中能量扇区的本征态模式与领头本征值的标度行为一致地支持该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够统一描述临界涨落的多尺度关联层级并给出可检验的有限尺寸标度预言，且有望推广至哈密顿量未知的系统。

title: Remark on internal relaxation in large number qubit systems
summary: For a time $t_{c}$ of calculation in an $N$ qubit quantum computer that is much shorter than the intrinsic Heisenberg time $t_H$, $t_c\ll t_H$, the dynamics of the system is effectively irreversible and the couplings between the qubits give rise to a relaxation time scale $\tau_r$. If $t_H\gg t_c >\sim \tau_r$ one looses quantum coherence exponentially fast. Since $t_H$ scales exponentially with $N$ there is a threshold $N_c$ such that for $N\gg N_c$ one must be aware of possible intrinsic relaxation during calculation. As an order of magnitude estimation we find $N_c\approx \ln(\tau_r/T)$ where $T$ is a typical system specific oscillation time of a single qubit. $\tau_r$ can be estimated as the typical inverse transition rate between two parts of the system, one of which is treated as an environment of the other.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨多体量子计算中由量子比特间耦合引起的本征弛豫与退相干问题，指出当比特数超过阈值 $N_c\approx\ln(\tau_r/T)$ 时，计算时间内可能出现不可忽略的退相干。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于澄清：即便忽略外部环境，仅由量子比特之间的相互作用，是否会在有限计算时间内导致量子相干性丧失，从而限制可扩展量子计算的比特规模。
AI.method: 采用解析与时标比较的方法：将计算时间 $t_c$ 与内禀海森堡时间 $t_H$ 及弛豫时间 $\tau_r$ 作比较；利用 $t_H$ 随 $N$ 指数增长的标度关系，求解释放相干性所需的条件；并以系统中两部分（一部分视为另一部分的环境）之间的典型跃迁速率的倒数来估计 $\tau_r$。
AI.result: 在 $t_c\ll t_H$ 时系统动力学可视为有效不可逆；若 $t_H\gg t_c\gtrsim\tau_r$，相干性将指数式快速衰减。由此得到存在阈值 $N_c$，当 $N\gg N_c$ 时必须考虑本征弛豫，量级估计为 $N_c\approx\ln(\tau_r/T)$，$T$ 为单比特典型振荡时间。
AI.conclusion: 量子比特间耦合导致的本征退相干构成了大规模量子计算的一个基本标度限制，其阈值仅随 $\ln(\tau_r/T)$ 对数增长，因此比特数增大到一定规模后，本征弛豫不可忽略。

title: CSS circuits are ICM circuits without magic states
summary: Gidney and Jones recently introduced ``CSS circuits'', generated by $X$, $Z$, $\MX$, $\MZ$ and CNOT, and showed that they can be sampled with $O(1)$ work per gate. They suspected that the class had been seen before. We point out that it is, up to a normal form, the initialisation--CNOT--measurement (ICM) form introduced in 2015 for compiling fault-tolerant circuits, restricted to $\ket{0}$ and $\ket{+}$ initialisations. The ICM construction answers constructively their question about ``non-CSS-ness as a resource'': every Clifford$+T$ circuit compiles to a CSS circuit acting on $\ket{Y}$ and $\ket{A}$ input states.

AI.tldr: Gidney与Jones提出的CSS电路（由X、Z、MX、MZ与CNOT生成）在规范形式下即为2015年ICM（初始化-CNOT-测量）形式（限于|0⟩和|+⟩初始化）；并给出Clifford+T电路到作用于|Y⟩、|A⟩输入态的CSS电路的构造性编译。
AI.motivation: Gidney与Jones引入CSS电路并猜测该电路类此前已被研究过；作者希望确认其与已有电路形式的对应关系，并回答"非CSS性作为资源"这一疑问。
AI.method: 通过形式等价性分析：将CSS电路（在规范形式下）识别为2015年为容错电路编译而提出的ICM形式，且后者被限制在|0⟩与|+⟩初始化上；再借助ICM构造给出显式编译方案。
AI.result: 证明CSS电路与受限ICM形式在规范形式下等价；并构造性地给出编译：任意Clifford+T电路均可编译为作用于|Y⟩与|A⟩输入态的CSS电路。
AI.conclusion: CSS电路并非新电路类，而是ICM形式的特例；"非CSS性"可由非稳定态输入（|Y⟩、|A⟩）承载，从而在ICM框架下得到构造性解释。

title: The Kitaev model on finite hyperbolic PBC clusters
summary: We construct and solve the three-colored Kitaev model on finite hyperbolic lattices with periodic boundary conditions. We describe a self-contained procedure which uses finite quotients of orientation- preserving triangle groups to generate regular maps on compact genus-g surfaces. From these, one can extract their lattice connectivity, plaquette structure, homology cycles and Wilson sectors while implementing consistent boundary conditions. On the example of {8, 3} and {12, 3} lattices, we enumerate a selection of quotients with up to 72 vertices, which constitute the discrete steps in a finite-size scaling analysis. For the isotropic point, corresponding to the spin-liquid phase in the thermodynamic limit, we identify the ground state superselection sectors, quantify their deviation from the homogeneous {\pi} flux sector and show how the selected flux background depends on the quotient geometry. We then discuss how the resulting ground state sector degeneracies are entirely generated by physical lattice symmetries acting on both the plaquette fluxes and non-contractible Wilson loops. Finally, we study the behaviour of the finite-size two-vison gap and matter fermion correlations. We find that the gap does not decrease monotonically with increasing system size, while one still recovers the expected algebraic decay of the correlations at the isotropic point, even for the considered modest system sizes.

AI.tldr: 该工作构建并求解了有限双曲格点（{8,3}与{12,3}）上的三色Kitaev模型，借助三角群有限商生成紧致亏格g曲面上的正则映射，系统研究各向同性自旋液体相中的基态超选择区、通量背景、Wilson环、两vison能隙与物质费米子关联。
AI.motivation: 双曲格点上Kitaev模型的有限尺寸研究缺乏自洽的边界条件与拓扑扇区处理框架；需要在有限体系中检验自旋液体相的通量结构、基态简并与关联衰减，并为热力学极限外推提供离散尺寸序列。
AI.method: 利用保持定向三角群的有限商构造紧致亏格g曲面上的正则映射，从中提取格点连通性、plaquette结构、同调循环与Wilson扇区并施加自洽边界条件；在{8,3}和{12,3}格点上枚举至多72个顶点的商作为有限尺寸序列；在各向同性点确定基态超选择区、量化其相对均匀π通量扇区的偏离，并分析通量背景对商几何的依赖；进而论证基态扇区简并完全由物理格点对称性（作用于plaquette通量与不可收缩Wilson环）生成；最后计算有限尺寸两vison能隙与物质费米子关联。
AI.result: 在各向同性点识别出基态超选择区，其偏离均匀π通量扇区的程度依赖于商几何；基态扇区简并可由格点对称性完全解释；两vison能隙随体系增大并非单调减小；即便在中等尺寸下，关联仍呈现预期的幂律（代数）衰减。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于三角群商的构造为双曲Kitaev模型提供了可控的有限尺寸框架；数值结果表明双曲自旋液体相的拓扑性质与关联行为可在有限体系中可靠探测，能隙的非单调行为提示有限尺寸效应的复杂性。

title: QEDist: Practical Exact Distance Certification for Stabilizer Codes
summary: We present QEDist, a method and software package that certifies the distance of qubit stabilizer codes. Building on tree-search methods, QEDist constructs candidate logical operators one qubit at a time, using sparse parity checks, stabilizer equivalence, and verified symmetries to reduce the work. For a cutoff $W$, a completed search either finds a nontrivial logical operator of weight at most $W$ or proves that none exists. Because satisfying one check can violate another, we use both satisfied and unsatisfied checks to lower-bound the weight needed to complete a logical operator, and prune branches whose bound exceeds the remaining budget, which substantially reduces net search time. We benchmark QEDist mainly on Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes; the same formulation extends to non-CSS codes and to the fault distance of syndrome-extraction circuits. For lifted-product (LP) codes, we further exploit the product structure to replace part of the full-code search with a smaller search on a classical constituent. We establish exact distances for codes with up to several thousand qubits, including Abelian and non-Abelian LP codes whose distances were previously reported only as upper bounds. In several seconds of search on one laptop core, QEDist certifies exact distances up to 20 for many of these codes and fault distance 10 for the syndrome-extraction circuit of the $[[144,12,12]]$ code. With orders-of-magnitude speedups over the tested exact solvers, QEDist makes exact distance certification a practical tool for selecting and optimizing finite-length quantum codes.
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code available at  this https URL

AI.tldr: QEDist：基于树搜索+校验下界剪枝的量子稳定子码距离精确认证方法与软件，可在单核数秒内认证数千量子比特码的精确距离（最高20）及[[144,12,12]]码提取电路故障距离10。
AI.motivation: 有限长度量子码的选型与优化需要"精确"距离认证，而现有精确求解器在大码上计算代价过高；许多LP码的距离此前仅有上界。
AI.method: 逐量子比特构造候选逻辑算符的树搜索：利用稀疏奇偶校验、稳定子等价与已验证对称性缩减搜索空间；对截断权重W，搜索要么找到权重≤W的非平凡逻辑算符，要么证明其不存在。关键创新是同时用已满足与未满足的校验来下界"完成逻辑算符所需权重"，并对下界超出剩余预算的分支剪枝；对LP码利用乘积结构，将全码搜索部分替换为对经典分量码的较小搜索。主要面向CSS码，形式化可扩展至非CSS码与症候提取电路故障距离。
AI.result: 对多达数千量子比特的码给出精确距离，包括此前仅有上界的Abelian与非Abelian LP码；在单笔记本单核数秒内认证许多码的精确距离达20，并给出[[144,12,12]]码症候提取电路的故障距离10；相比所测精确求解器实现数量级加速。
AI.conclusion: QEDist使精确距离认证成为有限长度量子码选择与优化的实用工具。

title: The SymTFT and Quantum Phases of Matter
summary: The symmetry topological field theory (SymTFT) provides a unified framework for ordinary and generalized symmetries of quantum many-body systems. By encoding symmetry in a topological theory in one higher dimension, it separates symmetry data from the details of a specific quantum system. In this review, we give a pedagogical introduction to this framework and survey its applications to phases of quantum matter. For fusion category symmetries in ${(1+1)}$d, we explain how the SymTFT characterizes anomalies, classifies gapped phases, and organizes the symmetry structure of gapless phases. We also give a broad overview of further developments of this framework, including extensions to symmetries in higher dimensions, continuous symmetries, fermionic systems, mixed states, and spacetime symmetries.
comment: Review article, to appear in "Annual Review of Condensed Matter Physics"

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于对称性拓扑场论（SymTFT）的综述，系统介绍该框架并梳理其在量子物质相研究中的应用。
AI.motivation: 普通对称性与广义对称性的研究缺乏统一框架，SymTFT通过在高一维的拓扑理论中编码对称性，将对称性数据与具体量子系统细节分离，从而提供统一描述。
AI.method: 以教学式（pedagogical）方式介绍SymTFT框架；针对(1+1)维融合范畴对称性，阐述SymTFT如何刻画反常、分类有能隙相并组织无能隙相的对称性结构；并综述向高维对称性、连续对称性、费米子系统、混合态及时空对称性等方向的推广。
AI.result: SymTFT能够统一处理普通与广义对称性，在(1+1)维融合范畴对称性情形下有效刻画反常、实现有能隙相分类，并描述无能隙相的对称性结构；框架可推广至多维、连续、费米子、混合态及时空对称性等情形。
AI.conclusion: SymTFT为量子多体系统的对称性及其相结构提供了统一而系统的语言，具有广泛的适用性与可扩展性。

title: Constraints on the volume enclosed by Fermi surfaces
summary: A fundamental property of a Fermi liquid (FL) is that the volume enclosed by the Fermi surface is determined by $\rho$, the total density of electrons. In a fractionalized Fermi liquid (FL*), the volume enclosed by the Fermi surface is determined by the same expression after $\rho$ has been shifted by a quantized amount, most commonly to $\rho -1$ (we assume spin rotation invariance, for simplicity). The FL* shift is related to the quantized symmetry fractionalization data of a quantum spin liquid, whose fractionalized spinon excitations are present alongside the Fermi surface quasiparticles. In this review article, we establish the FL* Fermi volume by generalizing the original Luttinger proof for FL to parton gauge theories of the quantum spin liquid and FL*. We also discuss Oshikawa's flux insertion arguments for FL, and their extension to FL*, including a discussion of gapless spin liquids.
comment: 24 pages, 5 figure. For the Special Centenary Issue of the Indian Journal of Physics, Recent Trends in Condensed Matter Physics

AI.tldr: 该综述将Luttinger定理推广到部分子规范理论，确立FL*费米面体积由ρ-1（量子化偏移）决定，并讨论Oshikawa磁通插入论证在FL*（含无能隙自旋液体）中的推广。
AI.motivation: 费米液体（FL）的基本性质是费米面包围体积由电子总密度ρ决定；而分数化费米液体（FL*）中该体积对应ρ减去一个量子化量（通常为ρ-1），这一偏移源自量子自旋液体的量子化对称分数化数据。本文旨在系统建立FL*的费米体积确定规则。
AI.method: 将原始Luttinger对FL的证明推广到量子自旋液体与FL*的部分子（parton）规范理论；同时讨论Oshikawa对FL的磁通插入论证，并推广至FL*，包括对无能隙自旋液体的分析。
AI.result: 在部分子规范理论框架下确立了FL*的费米面体积由ρ-1（自旋旋转不变情形）给出，并将其与自旋液体的对称分数化量子化数据相联系；磁通插入论证亦可扩展至FL*.
AI.conclusion: FL*中费米体积的量子化偏移根植于自旋液体的对称分数化拓扑数据，可通过推广的Luttinger与Oshikawa论证严格确定，为区分FL与FL*提供判据。

title: Black holes as black boxes: a query lower bound on python's lunch decoding
summary: The python's lunch conjecture relates the complexity of bulk reconstruction in holographic tensor networks to an exponential cost associated with post-selection. We establish a tight query lower bound for this decoding problem in a Haar random oracle model, with a python's lunch circuit that applies Haar random unitary $U$ to a logical input and fixed ancillas, followed by post-selection on $m$ output qubits. Given one copy of the normalized encoded state and coherent oracle access to $U$ and $U^\dagger$, including controlled queries, we prove that recovering even a single logical bit with constant average advantage requires $\Omega(2^{m/2})$ queries. Together with the state-independent amplitude amplification upper bound for approximately isometric encodings, this establishes query complexity $\Theta(2^{m/2})$ at constant decoding accuracy. We also comment on the decoding cost for other "admissible'" ensembles of unitaries $U$ which give rise to families of approximately isometric holographic maps.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Haar随机oracle模型下为"python's lunch"解码问题建立了紧的查询下界与上界，证明在常数解码精度下查询复杂度为Θ(2^{m/2})。
AI.motivation: python's lunch猜想将全息张量网络中的体（bulk）重构复杂度与后选择的指数代价联系起来，但此前缺乏严格的下界证明。本文旨在为这一猜想提供可证明的查询复杂度刻画。
AI.method: 在Haar随机oracle模型中构造python's lunch电路：对逻辑输入与固定辅助比特施加Haar随机酉U，再对m个输出量子比特做后选择。给定一份归一化编码态的副本，并具备对U和U†的相干oracle访问（含受控查询），证明即使以常数平均优势恢复单个逻辑比特也需Ω(2^{m/2})次查询；结合与态无关的振幅放大上界（适用于近似等距编码），得到紧界。文中还讨论了其他"容许"酉系综的解码代价。
AI.result: 恢复单个逻辑比特、常数平均优势需Ω(2^{m/2})次查询；结合振幅放大上界，得到常数精度下Θ(2^{m/2})的紧查询复杂度。对其他产生近似等距全息映射的"容许"酉系综亦给出解码代价评述。
AI.conclusion: 首次严格确立了python's lunch猜想的查询复杂度指数级下界，并以匹配的上界给出紧的Θ(2^{m/2})结论，为全息体重构的后选择代价提供了可证明的基础，并推广到更一般的容许酉系综。

title: Cyclic Boson Stars with Quantum Vortex Molecules
summary: We find a new type of stationary boson star with cyclic rotational symmetry in the minimal model of complex scalar field coupled to gravity. Unlike conventional axisymmetric spinning boson stars, these configurations can carry noninteger angular momentum per particle in units of the reduced Planck constant, revealing a new way for boson stars to carry angular momentum. We identify the vortex assemblies within these stars as self-gravitating quantum vortex molecules, in which gravity supports a stationary vortex arrangement despite internal circulation. These structures provide a relativistic realization of quantum vortex molecules studied in condensates and motivate possible laboratory analogues.

AI.tldr: 在复标量场与引力耦合的最小模型中，发现一类具有循环转动对称性的新型定态玻色星，其单粒子角动量可为约化普朗克常数的非整数倍。
AI.motivation: 传统轴对称自旋玻色星的角动量只能取整数倍，角动量携带方式受限；作者希望拓展玻色星携带角动量的机制。
AI.method: 在最小耦合的复标量场—引力模型中构造具有循环（离散转动）对称性的定态解，并分析恒星内部的涡旋排布。
AI.result: 获得可携带非整数单位角动量的定态玻色星解；其内部涡旋组态表现为自引力"量子涡旋分子"，即在内禀环流存在下仍由引力维持的定态涡旋结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出量子涡旋分子的相对论实现，联系凝聚态体系中的类似物，并为实验室模拟提供可能途径。

title: Modular Hamiltonian and modular flow of a massive scalar in an interval
summary: We obtain the vacuum modular Hamiltonian of a free massive scalar in an interval, for any $mL$. Its eigenvectors are superpositions of massive plane waves emitted from the two end points, with amplitudes given by a linear integral equation whose Neumann series is an expansion in reflections, and a normalization fixed by a Painlevé V transcendent. We follow the modular flow of initially localized wave packets inside the causal diamond. The flow is not geometric: the commutator profiles spread and can develop peaks ahead of the conformal trajectory.

AI.tldr: 该文给出自由大质量标量场在区间内对任意 mL 的真空模哈密顿量显式解：本征矢为两端点发出的大质量平面波叠加，振幅由线性积分方程（Neumann 级数呈反射展开）确定，归一化由 Painlevé V 超越函数固定；并追踪局域波包的模流，发现其非几何性。
AI.motivation: 模哈密顿量是纠缠与模流研究的核心对象，但自由大质量场在区间（因果菱形）上的真空模哈密顿量此前仅有共形（无质量）情形或小质量极限的已知结果，缺乏对任意 mL 的精确刻画，因而无法定量讨论质量对模流几何性的破坏。
AI.method: 取一维区间的真空态，求解自由大质量标量场的模哈密顿量本征问题：将本征矢展开为从区间两端点发出的大质量平面波的叠加，把本征方程化为关于振幅的线性积分方程；用反射展开的 Neumann 级数求解，并以 Painlevé V 超越函数确定归一化。随后在此模哈密顿量下演化初始局域化的波包，计算对易子的分布剖面。
AI.result: 得到对任意 mL 成立的模哈密顿量本征矢与本征值结构；模流对局域波包不再几何，对易子剖面随模时间展宽，并可在共形轨迹前方出现额外峰。
AI.conclusion: 质量使区间真空模流偏离共形变换所预言的几何流，其偏差可被解释为多次反射（Neumann 级数各项）的累积效应；模哈密顿量的 Painlevé V 结构提示与可积性及半经典/大质量渐近分析的联系。

title: A Proposal for Quantum Reference Frames in Quantum Field Theory and their Experimental Exploration
summary: We construct quantum reference frames (QRFs) in quantum field theory, using localized modes of a scalar field as frames for its shift symmetry. We import tools from relativistic quantum information to explicitly compute entropies and correlation measures of relational observables, investigating their frame dependence and the new features arising from the field-theoretic character of the system. Unlike QRFs for systems with finitely many degrees of freedom, localized field-theoretic QRFs are necessarily mixed in physically relevant states and generically correlated with the subsystems they describe. These aspects of QRFs for fields affect the properties of relational observables in a subtle way. Furthermore, we put forward a proposal for testing these predictions with existing quantum simulators based on ultracold atoms and quantum fluids, thus connecting QRF physics with analogue gravity platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文在量子场论中构建以标量场局域模式为参考系的量子参考系（QRF），计算关系型可观测量的熵与关联度，揭示其框架依赖及场论特征带来的新效应，并提出用超冷原子与量子流体量子模拟器检验的方案。
AI.motivation: 以往QRF研究多针对有限自由度系统，缺乏场论情形下的系统性分析；本文旨在填补这一空白，并探索与模拟引力平台的实验联系。
AI.method: 以标量场的局域模式作为位移对称性的参考系构建QRF，引入相对论量子信息工具，显式计算关系型可观测量的熵与关联度量，分析其框架依赖性与场论新特征。
AI.result: 与有限自由度情形不同，场论中的局域QRF在物理相关态下必然为混合态，并通常与被描述子系统存在关联；这些特性以微妙方式影响关系型可观测量的性质。文章还提出基于超冷原子与量子流体的量子模拟器检验方案。
AI.conclusion: 场论型QRF的混合性与关联性改变了关系型可观测量的行为，且该预言可通过现有量子模拟平台在类比引力框架下检验。

title: Center anomalies without twists: torsion, exact degeneracies, and condensates
summary: Mixed center anomalies are usually exposed by 't Hooft's twisted boundary conditions in a Hamiltonian formalism. On $\mathbb {RP}^3$, torsion makes the twist unnecessary: a center operator on the untwisted $SU(2)$ Hilbert space anticommutes with time reversal in Yang-Mills theory at $\theta=\pi$ and with the chiral symmetry of super Yang-Mills theory, so every level is at least doubly degenerate. The relevant semiclassical object is the BPST instanton, which descends to a charge-$\tfrac12$ saddle on the orbifold $\mathbb R^4/\mathbb Z_2$. We complete it in two ways: applying a conformal transformation maps the orbifold to $\mathbb R\times\mathbb {RP}^3$, with the saddle describing the tunneling event between the two center sectors; by resolving the orbifold singularity, we obtain the Eguchi-Hanson space, which gives the gaugino condensate at its weak-coupling value.

AI.tldr: 在$\mathbb{RP}^3$上无需't Hooft扭曲，靠挠率与中心算符即可暴露混合中心反常（导致能级二重简并），其半经典对应为$\mathbb{R}^4/\mathbb{Z}_2$上的电荷1/2 BPST鞍点，可经共形映射或Eguchi-Hanson解奇点两种方式完成。
AI.motivation: 通常用't Hooft扭曲边界条件才能在哈密顿量形式中揭示混合中心反常；作者寻求在$\mathbb{RP}^3$上无需扭曲即可暴露该反常的途径。
AI.method: 在$\mathbb{RP}^3$上利用挠率（torsion）省略扭曲，构造与时间反演（$\theta=\pi$的Yang-Mills）和手征对称性（超Yang-Mills）反对易的中心算符；以BPST instanton下投到orbifold $\mathbb{R}^4/\mathbb{Z}_2$上的电荷1/2鞍点为半经典对象，分别经共形变换映射到$\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{RP}^3$（描述两中心扇区间的隧穿事件）以及通过解奇点得到Eguchi-Hanson空间。
AI.result: 中心算符与时间反演/手征对称性反对易，导致每一能级至少二重简并；电荷1/2鞍点描述中心扇区间隧穿；Eguchi-Hanson解析给出弱耦合下的gaugino凝聚值。
AI.conclusion: $\mathbb{RP}^3$上的挠率使扭曲变得不必要，从而以BPST instanton下投所得的电荷1/2鞍点为核心，统一刻画中心反常简并、中心扇区隧穿与gaugino凝聚。

title: Parametric and Universal Thouless Invariants in Matrix Product States
summary: We investigate the classification of continuous families of translation-invariant injective matrix product states on an infinite chain, parametrized by a paracompact Hausdorff space $X$ and subject to a compact Hausdorff symmetry $G$. We construct an invariant for phases of such families, valued in $\check{H}^1(X;\widehat{G})$, that generalizes the known $\widehat{G}$ phase invariant for $G$-symmetric Thouless pumps. The phase invariant is constructed as the pullback to $X$ of a single universal Čech cohomology class on a classifying space of $G$-symmetric translation-invariant injective matrix product states. Several examples are given over various parameter spaces where this invariant is nontrivial.

AI.tldr: 对无限链上平移不变单射矩阵乘积态（MPS）的连续族，在紧致Hausdorff对称群G下构造了取值于Čech上同调Ẑ^1(X;Ĝ)的相不变量，推广了G对称Thouless泵的Ĝ相不变量，并给出非平凡例子。
AI.motivation: 已有的Ĝ相不变量主要针对G对称Thouless泵（参数空间为圆环等特定空间）这一情形，缺乏对一般参数空间X上MPS连续族的统一分类工具。作者希望把该不变量推广到以任意仿紧Hausdorff空间X为参数、具有紧致Hausdorff对称G的平移不变单射MPS族，从而给出更普遍的相分类框架。
AI.method: 在仿紧Hausdorff参数空间X上考察平移不变单射MPS的连续族，并要求其具有紧致Hausdorff群G的对称作用。构造方式是把X上族的不变量实现为某个通用Čech上同调类的拉回：先在与G对称平移不变单射MPS相对应的分类空间上构造一个单一的通用Čech类，再通过分类映射将其拉回到X，得到取值于Čech上同调群Ẑ^1(X;Ĝ)的相不变量。随后在若干具体参数空间上计算该不变量以给出非平凡实例。
AI.result: 成功构造了取值于Čech上同调Ẑ^1(X;Ĝ)的相不变量，它是G对称Thouless泵已知Ĝ相不变量的推广；通过在多种参数空间上给出的例子，证明了该不变量可以取非平凡值，说明该分类工具确实能区分不同的MPS相族。
AI.conclusion: 平移不变单射MPS的连续族在对称群G下的相分类可由Ẑ^1(X;Ĝ)中的不变量刻画；该不变量具有"通用Čech类拉回"的函子性结构，并自然包含Thouless泵情形作为特例。这为参数空间为一般拓扑空间的对称MPS族提供了统一的相不变量框架。

title: Tunable Topological Charge Order in Magnetic Moiré Systems
summary: Two-dimensional electrons in a strong magnetic field exhibit two seemingly incompatible ground states: incompressible quantum Hall liquids with a quantized Hall conductance, and electron crystals in which interactions drive the charge into ordered patterns. Moiré superlattices in transition-metal-dichalcogenide bilayers offer a tunable arena for this competition. Using neural quantum states (NQS) together with several methodological advances, we show how this competition unfolds. In particular, we demonstrate that the two end points are separated by an extended regime in which molecular charge order coexists with a quantized Hall response. We map the ground-state phase diagram of electrons at Landau-level filling $\nu_B=1$ in the presence of a moiré superlattice potential, with three electrons per moiré cell. In the deep triangular potential limit, the electrons form the topologically trivial "Wigner molecular crystal'' of three-electron artificial atoms, a state recently imaged at zero magnetic field in moiré bilayers. As the potential depth is lowered, molecular charge order remains while quantized Hall response emerges. At the honeycomb point, where each cell contains three electrons and two degenerate moiré minima, wells are either singly or doubly occupied and the doublons provide an emergent Ising degree of freedom. Starting from modest interaction strength, we find short-range doublon correlations within the Chern insulator which grow with interaction strength and eventually break sublattice symmetry, forming a Néel CDW with long-range order between doublons. The topological molecular regime lies at twist angles and magnetic fields directly accessible to current experiments. The methodological advances presented provide a scalable framework for exploring a broad range of questions in correlated quantum matter in the presence of magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 结合神经量子态（NQS）方法，研究莫尔超晶格中强磁场下电子的量子霍尔液体与电子晶体竞争，揭示两者之间存在"分子电荷序与量子化霍尔响应共存"的扩展区间，并给出ν_B=1时的基态相图。
AI.motivation: 强磁场中二维电子存在两种看似不相容的基态：不可压缩的量子霍尔液体与相互作用驱动的电子晶体。TMD双层莫尔超晶格为研究这一竞争提供了可调控平台，但缺乏精确、可扩展的多体计算方法。
AI.method: 采用神经量子态（NQS）并配合多项方法学改进，对存在莫尔超晶格势、每个莫尔元胞含三个电子、朗道能级填充ν_B=1的体系进行基态求解，系统扫描三角势与蜂窝势极限，构建基态相图；并分析双占据（doublon）关联与对称性破缺。
AI.result: 1）深度三角势极限下电子形成拓扑平庸的"维格纳分子晶体"（三电子人造原子），与零磁场莫尔双层中的成像结果一致；2）随势深降低，分子电荷序保留而量子化霍尔响应出现，形成共存区；3）蜂窝点处每个元胞两简并势阱单/双占据，doublon提供涌现的Ising自由度；4）在陈绝缘体内出现短程doublon关联，随相互作用增强而增长，最终破坏亚晶格对称性形成长程有序的Néel CDW；5）该拓扑分子区对应的扭转角与磁场在当前实验可及范围内。
AI.conclusion: 量子霍尔液体与电子晶体之间存在由拓扑分子态构成的中间区，分子电荷序与量子化霍尔响应可共存；NQS方法为磁场下关联量子物质研究提供了可扩展框架。

title: Restoring quantum neural network trainability through reusable calibration
summary: Quantum neural networks (QNNs) rely on measured quantum observables to guide optimization, but hardware noise can suppress the parameter-dependent signals essential for learning. Here, we develop a structure-preserving error-mitigation framework that improves QNN trainability through reusable calibration of the quantum circuit's effective noise response. By calibrating a reference circuit with the same gate architecture as the trainable circuit, we construct regularized estimators of local quantum features that remain fixed throughout training. We quantify how calibration errors and response mismatches affect the recovery of both observables and their derivatives. Numerical simulations demonstrate enhanced loss-landscape contrast, faster convergence, and improved classification performance, and an IBM Quantum experiment confirms improved closed-loop variational optimization under hardware noise. We further demonstrate calibration reuse in a modular QNN comprising 25 independent four-qubit channels, corresponding to 100 qubits in aggregate. Our results establish reusable feature calibration as a practical approach to improving noise-limited quantum machine learning without repeated calibration at every training step.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结构保持的误差缓解框架，通过对与可训练电路门结构相同的参考电路做一次性可复用校准，构建固定于训练全程的局部量子特征正则化估计量，从而提升含噪量子神经网络的训练性能。
AI.motivation: 量子神经网络依赖测量可观测量来指导优化，但硬件噪声会压制对参数敏感的信号，损害可训练性；而逐训练步重复校准代价过高，缺乏实用性。
AI.method: 基于参考电路（与可训练电路具有相同门架构）校准其有效噪声响应，构建局部量子特征的正则化估计量并在训练中保持不变；理论量化校准误差与响应失配对可观测量及其导数恢复的影响；结合数值模拟与IBM Quantum硬件实验验证；在由25个独立四比特通道（合计100比特）构成的模块化QNN中演示校准复用。
AI.result: 数值模拟显示损失景观对比度增强、收敛更快、分类性能提升；IBM Quantum实验证实含硬件噪声下闭环变分优化得到改善；模块化QNN中成功实现校准复用。
AI.conclusion: 可复用特征校准是改善噪声受限量子机器学习的实用途径，无需在每个训练步重复校准。

title: Robust Passive Quantum Memory in Three Dimensions, Part I: Thermal and Zero-Temperature Perturbative Stability
summary: Whether a three-dimensional quantum many-body system with geometrically local, bounded-degree interactions can passively protect encoded quantum information has remained a central open question since Kitaev introduced topological quantum computation. Passive protection requires stability against both thermal noise at nonzero temperature and generic static Hamiltonian perturbations Balasubramanian, Davydova, and Lin (BDL) recently established unperturbed three-dimensional thermal self-correction using a recursively defined family of stabilizer Hamiltonians. However, they left open whether their construction remains stable against quantum perturbations, even at zero temperature. In this paper, we show that a slight variant of the BDL code family achieves stability along both boundary axes of the perturbation-temperature phase diagram as the system size grows. Following BDL, in the absence of perturbation it is thermally stable below a critical temperature, achieving a stretched-exponentially long memory lifetime when coupled to any local Markovian thermal bath generated by single-site system-bath interactions satisfying detailed balance with bounded coupling rates. At zero temperature under arbitrary weak, superpolynomially decaying quantum perturbations, the family maintains a uniform bulk spectral gap, superpolynomially small ground-space splitting, and a superpolynomially long closed-system unitary memory lifetime for quasi-locally dressed logical observables. To prove this zero-temperature stability, we establish local topological quantum order across the multiscale hierarchy using a linearly dilated relaxation of the usual Bravyi-Hastings-Michalakis criteria. In the companion paper, we combine the tools developed here with finite-temperature worldline cluster expansions to establish passive self-correction throughout the phase diagram's positive-temperature perturbed interior.

AI.tldr: 本文证明BDL三维自纠错稳定子码族的一个变体，在零温任意弱且超多项式衰减的量子微扰下仍保持均匀体能隙、超多项式小的基态空间劈裂与超多项式长的幺正记忆寿命，并沿相图两条边界（零温+有微扰、有限温+无微扰）实现被动稳定。
AI.motivation: 三维量子多体系统能否被动保护编码信息（同时抗热噪声与一般静态哈密顿量微扰）自Kitaev提出拓扑量子计算以来一直是核心开放问题；BDL虽用递规定义的稳定子哈密顿量实现了无微扰的三维热自纠错，但未解决其对量子微扰（即便零温）的稳定性，本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对BDL码族作轻微变体；无微扰时沿用BDL的有限温热稳定性论证（对满足详细平衡、耦合速率有界的单格点系统-浴相互作用所生成任意局部马尔可夫热浴给出拉伸指数记忆寿命）；零温下借助"线性膨胀松弛"版本的Bravyi-Hastings-Michalakis判据，在多尺度层级上建立局部拓扑量子序，从而证明能隙与基态劈裂的稳定性。
AI.result: 变体码族随系统尺寸增长在相图两条边界上稳定：有限温无微扰区呈热稳定、拉伸指数长记忆寿命；零温任意弱、超多项式衰减微扰下具有均匀体谱隙、超多项式小的基态空间劈裂，以及对准局部缀饰逻辑可观测量超多项式长的闭系统幺正记忆寿命。
AI.conclusion: 该构造沿微扰-温度相图的两条边界实现被动保护；作者预告在姊妹篇中结合本文工具与有限温世界线团簇展开，进一步证明相图正温微扰内部全域的被动自纠错。

title: Loss-Tolerant Quantum Correlations Between Atomic and Photonic Qubits
summary: Quantum physics forbids cloning of a qubit. Therefore, a qubit is irreversibly lost upon loss of the information carrier. To mitigate this physical loss, it has been proposed to distribute the logical information across an entangled set of physical qubits, some of which can be lost. Previous experiments illustrated this concept, but failed to demonstrate a gain in the information-retrieval efficiency. Here we address this challenge with photons for which the total loss, from generation to detection, is below the loss-tolerance threshold of $50\%$. Using two single-atom emitters in an optical cavity, we encode information into the photons of a graph state and observe an efficiency gain for retrieving quantum correlations between the atoms and the photons for single-qubit measurements in the Pauli $X$ and $Z$ bases. Although technical errors reduce the probability to obtain the \textit{correct} result, we achieve average fidelities as high as $\gtrsim\!70\%$ without and $\gtrsim\!75\%$ with error detection, demonstrating entanglement between the atomic and encoded photonic qubits. Lowering the encoding errors is a next natural step toward loss-tolerant photonic quantum-information processing.

AI.tldr: 利用腔内两个单原子发射体将信息编码进图态光子，总损耗低于50%阈值，首次观测到信息检索效率增益，无纠错与带错误检测的平均保真度分别约70%和75%。
AI.motivation: 量子不可克隆定理使信息载体一旦丢失，量子比特即不可逆丢失。理论上可用纠缠多个物理比特编码逻辑信息以容忍部分比特丢失，但此前实验仅演示了该概念，未能证明信息检索效率的正增益。
AI.method: 采用光腔中两个单原子发射体，将信息编码到图态（graph state）的光子中；系统总损耗（从产生到探测）控制在50%损耗容忍阈值以下；在单量子比特Pauli X与Z基测量下，评估原子—光子之间量子关联的检索效率，并比较有无错误检测（error detection）的情形。
AI.result: 观测到原子与光子之间量子关联检索的效率增益；尽管技术误差降低获得正确结果的概率，平均保真度在无错误检测时可达≳70%，带错误检测时达≳75%，证实了原子与编码光子比特之间的纠缠。
AI.conclusion: 实验首次在光子平台上展示了超越损耗容忍阈值条件的信息检索增益，验证了基于图态的损耗容忍编码方案的可行性；下一步需降低编码错误，以推进损耗容忍的光量子信息处理。

title: Distrustful entanglement-based Quantum Key Distribution
summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) is the one of the most explored application of quantum information theory. While practical QKD systems are being deployed around the world, a major issue of these setups are that one has to trust the measurement devices of both parties. On the other hand, the most secure among such schemes are called device-independent (DI) QKD protocols, where no component of the setup is assumed to be trusted. However, due to their high technological demand, their loophole-free version currently remain out of practical reach. Inspired by the real world, we consider the traditional QKD in a distrustful measurement setting, that is, the measurement devices can only be trusted upto some level of confidence, which might still be large but not completely trusted. We then derive a general lower bound on the asymptotic key rate in this scenario. Then considering perfect detectors and source, and the entanglement-based BB84 (BBM) protocol, we show that to obtain secure keys one needs to trust their devices more than 92 %. However, we observe that such a protocol can not be realised with any level of distrust using the realistic detectors and sources at the current technology. Finally, we also consider the BBM protocol with arbitrary dimensional systems and observe that they are more robust to distrust than qubit systems. Consequently, with the same level of distrust, along with same detector and source efficiences, one can get better key rates with high-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"测量设备需被部分信任"情形下的传统QKD，给出渐近密钥率的通用下界，并指出BBM协议需高于92%的信任度才能生成安全密钥，现实中难以实现，而高维系统对不信任更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 实用QKD系统必须信任双方测量设备，而安全性更高的设备无关（DI）QKD虽不假设任何组件可信，却因技术需求过高而无法实用化。作者希望在两者之间寻找折中：允许测量设备仅被"部分信任"。
AI.method: 将传统QKD置于不信任测量的框架下，用信任度（confidence level）刻画测量设备可信程度，推导该情形下渐近密钥率的通用下界；随后在理想探测器与源、纠缠型BB84(BBM)协议下计算所需信任阈值，并进一步推广到任意维度系统的BBM协议，结合现实探测器与源效率进行分析。
AI.result: 理想器件下，BBM协议需信任设备超过92%才能获得安全密钥；使用当前技术水平的现实探测器与源时，该协议在任何不信任程度下都无法实现；任意维度BBM协议比qubit系统对不信任更鲁棒，在相同信任度与相同探测器/源效率下高维系统可获得更高密钥率。
AI.conclusion: 部分信任测量为传统QKD与DI-QKD之间提供了可行折中，但qubit BBM对器件不信任极为敏感，需极高信任度；高维系统在同等不信任条件下更具优势，是提升实用QKD鲁棒性的有前景方向。

title: AI Scientist Discovered Robust Quantum Control
summary: Protecting quantum coherence is a central theme of modern quantum technologies. Carefully designed control pulses can extend coherence by suppressing disorder and unwanted interactions. However, designing robust pulse sequences remains challenging in interacting multi-level systems, where multiple independent error channels must be controlled in the presence of experimental imperfections. Here we introduce QORA, a multi-agent artificial intelligence framework that integrates theoretical reasoning, automated experimental calibration and control for closed-loop discovery of quantum control sequences. Applied to a dense ensemble of spin-1 nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond, QORA discovers AID-ROD, a series of AI-discovered sequences that nearly double the measured spin coherence time relative to the state-of-the-art human-designed sequence DROID-C3PO. Subsequence analysis by human researchers reveals a hierarchy of error suppression: 18-pulse blocks suppress linear and quadratic onsite disorder and common-mode drive-amplitude errors, while their arrangement over a longer cycle reduces dipolar interactions, providing a physical explanation for the observed improvement and robustness in AID-ROD. These results demonstrate AI-guided experimental discovery of robust quantum control and identify a design strategy for protecting coherence in interacting multi-level systems beyond qubits.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体AI框架QORA，闭环自动发现量子控制序列，在稠密NV色心系综中发现AID-ROD序列，相干时间较人类最优DROID-C3PO提升近一倍。
AI.motivation: 多能级相互作用体系中存在多个独立误差通道，实验不完美条件下设计鲁棒脉冲序列仍十分困难，需要新的自动化设计方法。
AI.method: QORA多智能体AI框架，融合理论推理、自动化实验标定与控制，实现闭环搜索；应用于金刚石中自旋-1 NV色心稠密系综，并通过人工子序列分析给出物理机制解释。
AI.result: 发现AID-ROD系列序列，测得自旋相干时间较最先进的人工设计序列DROID-C3PO提升近一倍；子序列分析显示18脉冲块可抑制线性与二次在位无序及共模驱动幅度误差，长周期排布降低偶极相互作用。
AI.conclusion: AI可引导实验发现鲁棒量子控制，并揭示在比特之外相互作用多能级体系中保护相干性的设计策略。

title: Quantum Reference Frames, Locality, and Microcausality in Quantum Field Theory
summary: As a consequence of the relativistic spectrum condition, quantum reference frames for translations on Minkowski space are never described by projection-valued measures, and in many cases fail a weaker spacetime localisation property known as the norm-$1$ condition. This has several implications for the local and observable structure of quantum field theories described relative to even the best available frame: for a large class of frame states, strict locality is replaced by almost locality, and microcausality by commutators that decay rapidly with increasing separation, corresponding to an effective smearing of the light cone by the localisation density of the frame state. Operations built from finitely many almost local Kraus operators, for example nonselective measurements of relativised local observables, satisfy an approximate no-signalling bound, with a residue attributable to the localisation uncertainty of the frame. Whether causality in its strongest operational form -- non-disturbance under all physically realisable operations -- survives relativisation is left open. An upshot of our finding is that quantum field theories formulated relative to a quantum reference frame cannot rest on the traditional axioms, and some general relational axiomatisation must replace at least some of them by taking into account physically realistic properties of the frame.

AI.tldr: 由于相对论谱条件，闵可夫斯基时空平移的量子参考系无法用投影值测度描述，且往往不满足范数-1局域化条件；这使相对化后的量子场论中严格局域性变为"几乎局域性"、微因果性变为随距离快速衰减的对易子（等效于以参考系态的局域化密度抹平光锥），有限个几乎局域Kraus算子构成的操作满足近似无信号界，最强操作意义下的因果性是否在相对化下存活仍悬而未决。
AI.motivation: 研究量子参考系（QRF）相对化对量子场论局域性与因果结构的影响：相对论谱条件使平移参考系无法由投影值测度（PVM）描述，且常违反范数-1条件，因此需要澄清"相对于量子参考系描述"的场论在局域性与可观测结构上究竟保留了多少传统公理内容。
AI.method: 以相对论谱条件为出发点，分析平移QRF的可观测量代数结构（非PVM、范数-1条件失效）；在此基础上考察相对化局域可观测量及由有限多个几乎局域Kraus算子构成的操作（如非选择性测量），推导其无信号性与非扰动性（non-disturbance）的偏离界，并将偏离量联系到参考系态的局域化密度/局域化不确定性。
AI.result: 对一大类参考系态：严格局域性退化为几乎局域性，微因果性退化为随间隔快速衰减的对易子，效果等价于用参考系态局域化密度对光锥作有效抹平；有限个几乎局域Kraus算子构成的操作满足近似无信号界，残差可归因于参考系的局域化不确定性。"在所有物理可实现操作下均无非扰动"这一最强操作形式因果性是否在相对化下成立，仍为开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 相对于量子参考系表述的量子场论不能建立在传统公理体系之上，至少部分公理须由顾及参考系物理现实性质的一般关系性（relational）公理化方案所取代。

title: Hidden convexity of the Eliashberg condensation energy: existence, uniqueness and continuity of the superconducting state
summary: Kiessling, Altshuler and Yuzbashyan conjectured the thermodynamic transition picture for the isotropic Eliashberg spin-chain functional with vanishing Coulomb pseudopotential: the normal state is the unique minimizer above and at a critical temperature, the superconducting minimizer below it is unique up to gauge, and the transition is continuous. We establish the nonlinear part of this picture. In the variables $\rho_n=\sin^2\theta_n$, the condensation energy restricted to the first quadrant is strictly convex, and folding any admissible chain into that quadrant cannot increase its energy. For every positive, non-increasing interaction with power-law decay, hidden convexity and a compactness estimate give existence and uniqueness of the minimizer up to gauge. The normal state minimizes the energy exactly when its quadratic form is non-negative, including marginal stability. Among admissible chains, a positive solution of the nonlinear Eliashberg equations exists exactly when the normal state is linearly unstable and is then unique. For temperature-dependent families with pointwise continuity and locally uniform decay bounds, the minimizing density is continuous in a weighted $\ell^1$ norm. Together with uniqueness of the linear-stability temperature, these results prove the thermodynamic conjectures for the $\gamma$-model, Einstein phonons and general phonon spectra; the phonon applications use separately established spectral input. Finite-dimensional algebraic and convex-analytic components are machine-checked in Lean. The proofs were obtained independently of concurrent work that reaches overlapping conclusions.
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. AI.tldr: 本文证明了各向同性Eliashberg自旋链泛函（库仑赝势为零）在热力学转变图像中的非线性部分：能量在变量ρ_n=sin²θ_n下于第一象限严格凸，折叠不增能量；对幂律衰减的正且非增相互作用，给出极小元的规范意义下存在唯一性，正常态恰在其二次型非负时取极小（含临界稳定），非线性Eliashberg方程正解存在当且仅当正常态线性不稳定且此时唯一；并证明温度族下极小密度在加权ℓ¹范数下连续，从而对γ模型、Einstein声子和一般声子谱证明热力学猜想。
AI.motivation: Kiessling、Altshuler与Yuzbashyan对零库仑赝势的各向同性Eliashberg自旋链泛函提出了热力学转变图像（临界温度上下正常态/超导态的唯一极小元及转变连续性）的猜想，此前缺乏严格证明；本文旨在建立该图像中的非线性部分，将猜想从启发式提升为定理。

title: Transient State Preservation of a Dissipative Qubit via Lyapunov Control
summary: Preserving quantum states in the presence of environmental decoherence remains a fundamental challenge for quantum information processing. This work investigates whether Hamiltonian Lyapunov feedback can transiently preserve the state of an open qubit by reshaping its trajectory under Markovian dissipation. A state-error Lyapunov function is adopted to derive an analytical feedback law for Lindblad dynamics, ensuring a nonincreasing Lyapunov function whenever the control sensitivities are nonzero. The analysis identifies the geometric conditions under which the feedback becomes ineffective, showing that control authority vanishes when the current and target Bloch vectors are collinear. Numerical simulations are performed for amplitude damping and pure dephasing using selected target states. Performance is evaluated through fidelity, accumulated infidelity, dwell time above a fidelity threshold, coherence, and control effort. The results demonstrate that the proposed feedback cannot eliminate irreversible dissipation or achieve universal asymptotic stabilization, but it can provide transient benefits for selected target-channel combinations. In particular, under amplitude damping, the controller significantly reduces accumulated infidelity and substantially extends the interval during which the system remains above a prescribed fidelity threshold. In the pure dephasing cases examined, improvements in fidelity are generally limited, although transient coherence preservation is observed for the oblique target considered, revealing a trade-off between coherence and state fidelity. These findings indicate that Lyapunov-based Hamiltonian feedback is best suited as a transient preservation mechanism and motivate its application to gate operations and preservation of prepared states during finite time intervals before their use or readout.

title: Microwave-optical quantum transduction with quantum-well exciton polaritons
summary: Linking superconducting quantum processors over optical fiber requires microwave-optical quantum transducers that are efficient, high-bandwidth, and low-noise. This combination has been out of reach because of the weak nonlinearities of conventional electro-optic (EO) materials. We propose a transducer with an engineered, strong EO nonlinearity using the quantum-confined Stark effect (QCSE) of quantum-well excitons. The QCSE transducer leverages the strong light-matter interactions and extreme polarizability of quantum well excitons. Strong coupling to an optical cavity forms exciton-polaritons whose vacuum EO coupling is up to five orders of magnitude larger than in a typical thin-film lithium niobate device. We describe a GaAs/AlGaAs stepped-quantum-well transducer design with predicted transduction efficiencies above 60% and fewer than 0.01 added noise quanta over a $\sim$60 MHz bandwidth, using pump powers below 10 $\mu$W and loaded optical and microwave quality factors of only $3\times10^4$ and $10^3$. We further show that the cavity protection of the polariton provides robustness against inhomogeneous broadening of the quantum well excitons.

AI.tldr: 提出基于量子阱激子量子限制斯塔克效应（QCSE）的强电光非线性微波-光量子换能器设计，预测在约60 MHz带宽下效率>60%、附加噪声<0.01量子，泵浦功率<10 μW。

title: Charge self-consistent DFT+QDMFT framework with a Krylov-based quantum impurity solver
summary: We integrate a quantum impurity solver into a charge self-consistent density functional theory (DFT) plus quantum dynamical mean-field theory framework. The solver optimizes adaptive circuits to approximate the ground state of the impurity model and its particle and hole excitations, and reconstructs the impurity Green's function from their Hamiltonian moments. Higher-order moments are predicted from low-order ones using a machine-learning model, while regularized optimization mitigates violations of causality in the resulting self-energy. The latter is used to update the charge density until self-consistency is achieved. We demonstrate the framework through body-centered cubic lithium calculations and compare the results with a reference one using a continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo solver. These calculations converge with root-mean-square charge-density residuals below $\boldsymbol{2\times10^{-3}}$ and yield a nearly vanishing impurity self-energy, consistent with the noninteracting limit used for weakly correlated lithium.

AI.tldr: 将自适应量子线路杂质求解器集成进电荷自洽DFT+DMFT框架，用机器学习外推哈密顿量矩重构杂质格林函数，并在bcc锂上验证其自洽性与正确性。

title: Infrared fluctuations and collective entanglement modes in harmonic lattices
summary:
We investigate how infrared fluctuations and spatial separation shape vacuum entanglement between two finite regions in the relativistic harmonic chain and its Lifshitz generalizations. At fixed lattice spacing and finite geometry, we establish that logarithmic negativity remains uniformly bounded as the mass approaches zero, while mutual information diverges. Infrared-enhanced total correlations therefore do not provide an unbounded distillable-entanglement resource. Using local symplectic consolidation, we identify the collective canonical modes carrying the negativity and follow their evolution with separation. Their participation crosses over from localization near the facing boundaries to a collective distribution within each region. Expansion in the adjacent-state canonical basis connects this evolution to progressively weaker, more extended reference modes, including adjacent-halo directions.
 Building on the established concentration of long-distance logarithmic negativity into a single canonical pair, we show that its spatial participation is smooth and infrared-dominated despite its ultraviolet canonical structure, a distinction also present in pure-state entanglement modes. These results refine the ultraviolet mode picture by resolving the long-wavelength organization of the oscillators participating in the surviving entanglement. Across the massless dispersions studied, the normalized participation approaches a universal long-distance profile when separation is scaled by the negativity radius. Its detailed form and the entanglement range nevertheless remain sensitive to ultraviolet deformations. Together, these findings distinguish infrared-enhanced correlations from distillable entanglement and reveal the collective spatial organization underlying its persistence at large separation.

AI.tldr: 在相对论谐振子链及其Lifshitz推广中，红外涨落使互信息发散，但对数负性在质量趋于零时保持有界；负性集中于单一正则模对，其空间参与在长距离下呈红外主导的普适剖面。
AI.motivation: 澄清红外增强的总关联是否等同于可蒸馏纠缠资源，并刻画大间距下存活纠缠在空间上的集体组织方式，以修正仅以紫外模式图像描述纠缠的不足。
AI.method: 在两有限区域的相对论谐振子链及Lifshitz色散推广中，固定晶格间距与几何，取质量趋于零极限，计算对数负性与互信息；采用局域辛（symplectic）整并对角化识别承载负性的集体正则模式，并在相邻态正则基下展开，追踪模式随间距的演化及参与度分布。
AI.result: 质量趋于零时对数负性一致有界而互信息发散；承载负性的集体模式参与度由面向边界处的局域化过渡为各区内的集体分布，并对应逐步变弱、更延展的参考模式（含adjacent-halo方向）；单一正则对的空问参与平滑且红外主导，与纯态纠缠模式类似；以负性半径为标度时归一化参与趋近普适长距离剖面，但其具体形式与纠缠范围对紫外形变敏感。
AI.conclusion: 红外增强的总关联与可蒸馏纠缠须区分：前者可无界，后者有界且由单一正则对承载；该纠缠的存活源于长波长振子的集体空间组织，其普适剖面与紫外敏感细节共存。

title: Quantum-Classical Separation in Probability Distribution Transport via Nonlocal Games
summary: In many-body physics and generative artificial intelligence, locality provides a natural notion of phase equivalence: two quantum states or classical probability distributions are regarded as in the same phase when local dynamics can reversibly transform one into the other. This raises a fundamental question: can local quantum dynamics transport classical probability distributions in ways that local classical dynamics cannot? We establish a quantum-classical separation in distribution transport: two classical distributions can be connected exactly and reversibly by a constant-depth local quantum circuit, whereas classical stochastic transport requires a substantially larger spatial range. We demonstrate this separation explicitly on a one-dimensional chain and develop a general construction principle on graphs, based on nonlocal games. Moreover, the source distribution can itself be generated by a simple local classical process, establishing a quantum advantage in distribution generation as well. Our results reveal a fundamental distinction between classical and quantum local reversibility, even when both the initial and final states are entirely classical.

AI.tldr: 该文证明：两个纯经典概率分布可被常数深度局域量子线路精确可逆地互转，而局域经典随机输运却需要大得多的空间作用范围，从而在分布输运上建立量子-经典分离，并给出基于非局域博弈的一般图构造原理。
AI.motivation: 多体物理与生成式AI中，局域性提供了相等价（phase equivalence）的自然判据：若局域动力学可逆地互转两个态，则视为同相。由此提出核心问题——局域量子动力学能否完成局域经典动力学无法完成的经典概率分布输运？即当初始与末态都完全经典时，量子局域可逆性是否严格强于经典局域可逆性。

AI.conclusion: 即使在初末态均为纯经典的情形下，经典与量子的局域可逆性仍存在根本区别，局域量子动力学在经典分布的输运与生成上具有本质优势。

title: Simple Models of Thermal Order in $2+1$ Dimensions
summary: Heating need not destroy order. We show that it persists to arbitrarily high temperatures in simple quantum field theories in $2+1$ spacetime dimensions. In a $\mathbb Z_2\times\mathbb Z_2$ model of two real scalar fields, a sufficiently negative mixed quartic coupling drives one field to condense, spontaneously breaking its $\mathbb Z_2$ symmetry. When coupled to massless Dirac fermions through a Yukawa interaction, this condensate generates a fermion mass, thereby spontaneously breaking parity and time-reversal symmetries. We extend this construction to a $\mathbb Z_2\times O(n)$ scalar model, in which the Mermin-Wagner theorem precludes spontaneous breaking of the continuous $O(n)$ symmetry at finite temperatures. Nevertheless, for $n=2$, a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless superfluid phase persists to arbitrarily high temperatures. In this phase, spatial correlations decay algebraically, with an exponent that approaches zero as the temperature increases. For $n\geq 3$, we uncover a further unexpected feature of these models: the characteristic size of ordered domains grows asymptotically with temperature, revealing an unusual enhancement of spatial correlations upon heating. We establish our results using a controlled high-temperature expansion, with selected findings corroborated by numerical functional renormalization group analysis. The simplicity of the field content in these models provides a promising starting point for exploring experimental realizations of persistent thermal order in thin-film materials.

AI.tldr: 在2+1维简单量子场论中，有序可以持续到任意高温：Z2×Z2双实标量模型通过负混合四次耦合使一个场凝聚并自发破缺Z2，经Yukawa耦合给无质量Dirac费米子生成质量，从而自发破缺宇称与时间反演；推广到Z2×O(n)标量模型中，n=2时BKT超流相持续至任意高温，n≥3时有序畴尺寸随温度渐近增长。结论基于受控高温展开并以泛函重整化群数值加以印证。

AI.method: 采用受控的高温展开（high-temperature expansion）作为主要解析手段；以Z2×Z2双实标量模型及推广的Z2×O(n)标量模型为对象，并通过引入Yukawa耦合的无质量Dirac费米子分析费米子质量生成；部分结论用数值泛函重整化群（functional renormalization group）加以交叉验证。
AI.result: 1）Z2×Z2模型中足够负的混合四次耦合驱动单一标量凝聚，自发破缺其Z2对称性；2）与无质量Dirac费米子Yukawa耦合后产生费米子质量，自发破缺宇称与时间反演；3）Z2×O(n)模型中虽受Mermin-Wagner定理限制，但n=2时存在持续至任意高温的BKT超流相，空间关联呈幂律衰减且指数随温度趋于零；4）n≥3时有序畴的特征尺寸随温度渐近增大，即加热反而增强空间关联。
AI.conclusion: 2+1维中热致有序可持续至任意高温，且存在BKT相持续性与高温下关联增强等反常行为；这些模型场内容简单，可作为薄膜材料中持久热有序实验实现的起点。

title: Shortest-path percolation and structural robustness of quantum internet networks
summary: We study shortest-path percolation on spatial networks that model the quantum internet based on optical fibers. In this process, the removal of paths describes the consumption of the entangled links used for communication. We compare finite and unrestricted path-length bounds for networks whose average degree either increases with system size or remains approximately constant. We show that networks become more robust as the average degree increases, whereas networks with approximately constant average degree exhibit a data collapse for the fixed finite bounds considered. Using Monte Carlo sampling of the shortest-path-length distribution, we estimate an equivalent path cost, a finite bound that approximately reproduces the degradation of the network in the unrestricted case. For networks with fixed average degree, this cost grows approximately as the square root of the number of nodes. Increasing the bound beyond this value requires additional computation time without appreciably changing the percolation dynamics. As a complementary result, for Erdős-Rényi random networks, we find an empirical relation between the initial average degree and the approximately common crossing point of the percolation curves for different path-length bounds.

AI.method: 在模拟量子互联网的空间网络上做最短路径渗流分析；对比平均度随规模增长与近似恒定的两类网络，比较有限与无限制路径长度上限；用蒙特卡洛抽样最短路径长度分布，估计可近似复现无限制情形的等效路径成本；并辅以Erdős–Rényi随机网络的实证分析。
AI.result: 平均度增大使网络更鲁棒；平均度近似恒定时，各固定有限上限的渗流曲线出现数据塌缩；等效路径成本随节点数约按平方根增长，超过该值后增加上限只增计算时间而不明显改变渗流动力学；Erdős–Rényi网络中初始平均度与不同路径长度上限渗流曲线的近似共同交点存在经验关系。
AI.conclusion: 有限路径长度上限在恒定平均度网络中可通过等效路径成本（约∝√N）有效代表无限制情形，为量子互联网渗流评估提供低成本近似准则。

title: Magnon-Phonon-Polariton Optomechanics in a van der Waals Magnet
summary: The layered anti-ferromagnet CrSBr hosts self-hybridized exciton-polaritons that couple parametrically to coherent magnons and phonons. In this work, we explore the tripartite optomechanical interaction between these quasiparticles in suspended CrSBr membranes supporting high-$Q$ breathing-type acoustic phonon modes. Using resonant pump-probe spectroscopy on the polariton state, we resolve the coupled dynamics in the $\simeq 20$ GHz range while sweeping the magnon mode across the phonon resonance with an external magnetic field. We observe an attractive magnon-phonon interaction of strength $V/2\pi = -43$ MHz, which primarily leads to phonon amplification. At the magnon-phonon resonance, we find predominantly unidirectional energy flow from magnons to phonons while the possible back-action is limited by kinetic losses of coherent magnons. Our study enables direct interfacing of collective magnetic excitations with sound and light in layered van der Waals materials, paving the way for quantum-coherent transduction in the GHz range with optical readout.

AI.tldr: 在悬浮CrSBr膜中利用高Q呼吸型声学声子，研究了自杂化激子极化激元与相干磁振子、声子之间的三体光力耦合；测得吸引型磁-声耦合V/2π = -43 MHz，主要表现为声子放大，共振处能量近乎单向由磁振子流向声子。
AI.motivation: 层状反铁磁体CrSBr可承载与相干磁振子和声子参数耦合的自杂化激子极化激元，作者希望在同一材料体系中直接研究这三种准粒子之间的相互作用，为GHz频段的量子相干换能与光学读出提供途径。
AI.method: 制备支撑高Q呼吸型声学声子模的悬浮CrSBr膜；对极化激元态进行共振泵浦-探测光谱，分辨约20 GHz范围内的耦合动力学；并用外磁场扫描磁振子模，使其扫过声子共振。
AI.result: 观测到吸引型磁-声相互作用，强度V/2π = -43 MHz，主要导致声子放大；在磁-声共振处，能量以磁振子向声子的单向流动为主，反向作用受相干磁振子动力学损耗的限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了层状范德华材料中集体磁激发与声、光的直接接口，为GHz频段兼具光学读出的量子相干换能奠定基础。

title: Magnetic tuning of odd elastic instabilities in chiral active crystals
summary: We investigate the dynamical properties of an odd active crystal whose elementary units follow an inertial dynamics and experience a Lorentz force induced by an external magnetic field. The continuous injection of energy associated with active chirality gives rise to odd elasticity, manifested through transverse forces between the crystal constituents. We show that the interplay between the magnetic field and these transverse forces produces a distinctive long-wavelength instability at vanishing wavevector, which is absent in both non-magnetic elastic crystals and passive crystals subjected to a magnetic field. Moreover, the magnetic field provides a means of tuning the collective oscillations of the crystal, enabling the emergence of exceptional points and tuning the dynamical instability induced by odd elasticity at finite wavevectors. Our analytical results yield explicit predictions for the displacement spectrum, static structure factor, and intermediate scattering function. These findings suggest that magnetic fields could provide a powerful tool for controlling collective phenomena in high-density systems of granular or colloidal spinners.

AI.tldr: 研究了处于外磁场中、具有惯性动力学与主动手性的"奇主动晶体"，揭示磁场与奇弹性横向力耦合会产生零波矢长波不稳定性，并可调控集体振荡、实现奇异点。
AI.motivation: 主动手性导致的能量持续注入产生奇弹性（组分间横向力），而外磁场通过洛伦兹力提供另一类横向耦合；两者如何共同影响晶体的集体动力学与稳定性尚不清楚，故本文探讨磁场与奇弹性横向力之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 构建连续介质/动力学理论模型：晶体基本单元遵循含惯性的动力学并受外磁场洛伦兹力作用，在奇弹性（横向力）框架下作线性化与长波分析，求解色散关系，并导出位移谱、静态结构因子与中间散射函数的解析表达式。
AI.result: 发现磁场与奇弹性横向力的耦合在波矢趋于零处产生独特的的长波不稳定性，该不稳定性在无非磁弹性晶体与受磁场的被动晶体中均不存在；磁场可调控晶体集体振荡，使系统出现奇异点（exceptional points），并能调节有限波矢下由奇弹性引起的动力学不稳定性；给出位移谱、静态结构因子与中间散射函数的显式预测。
AI.conclusion: 磁场可作为调控高密度颗粒或胶体自旋体（spinners）体系集体现象的有力工具，为主动手性系统的稳定性与动力学控制提供理论与可测量预言。

title: Quantum Fisher information matrices for time-evolved bosonic Gaussian thermal states
summary: Quantum Fisher information (QFI) is a fundamental quantum metrological quantity arising from the second order term in a Taylor expansion of a smooth divergence evaluated at nearby quantum states. The $\alpha$-$z$ information matrix is a QFI measure arising from the $\alpha$-$z$ Rényi relative entropy, and QFI measures corresponding to various underlying smooth divergences may be recovered from the $\alpha$-$z$ information matrix, including the standard symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) QFI. Bosonic Gaussian states are common probe states for quantum metrological tasks and admit a complete characterization in terms of their first and second moments. In this work, we consider the quantum metrological task of estimating parameters that characterize a Gaussian unitary time evolution of a faithful bosonic Gaussian thermal state. We establish a formula for the $\alpha$-$z$ information matrix of faithful bosonic Gaussian thermal states that have undergone a Gaussian unitary time evolution. As an example, we calculate entries of the $\alpha$-$z$ information matrix for a two-mode Gaussian thermal state that has undergone a beam splitting operation. For a parametrized family of time-evolved bosonic Gaussian states, we also derive a formula for the SLD operator, which is known to provide a measurement scheme that saturates the quantum Crámer-Rao bound and thus achieves the ultimate precision for single parameter estimation.

AI.tldr: 该文给出经过高斯幺正时间演化的忠实玻色高斯热态的α-z信息矩阵解析公式，并进一步推导SLD算符的表达式，可用于单参数估计的最优测量。
AI.motivation: 量子Fisher信息（QFI）是量子度量学的核心量，可由不同光滑散度的二阶项导出；α-z信息矩阵由α-z Rényi相对熵产生，可退化出包括SLD-QFI在内的多种QFI度量。玻色高斯态是常用探针态且由一、二阶矩完全刻画，但缺乏对经高斯幺正时间演化的高斯热态的α-z信息矩阵的系统计算，故本文予以补足。
AI.method: 从α-z Rényi相对熵出发定义α-z信息矩阵；利用忠实玻色高斯热态的一、二阶矩刻画，推导其在一般高斯幺正时间演化下α-z信息矩阵的解析公式；以两模高斯热态经分束器操作为例计算矩阵元；并对参数化时间演化高斯态族推导SLD算符公式。
AI.result: 建立了忠实玻色高斯热态经高斯幺正时间演化后α-z信息矩阵的通用公式；给出两模高斯热态经分束操作时α-z信息矩阵各元素的具体计算；导出了参数化时间演化的玻色高斯态族的SLD算符公式，该算符对应可饱和量子Cramér-Rao界的测量方案。
AI.conclusion: α-z信息矩阵为统一处理多种QFI度量提供了框架，其对高斯热态时间演化的解析结果与SLD算符公式，为基于高斯探针的单参数量子估计达到最终精度提供了可操作的测量方案。

title: A Geometric Framework for Local-to-Global Symmetry: Global Constraints on Local Dynamics
summary: Aggregate molecular systems are routinely understood by decomposing them into local structural units, such as monomers in J/H-aggregates, chemical moieties, motifs, and functional groups. Implicit in such decompositions is the assumption that these local structures remain meaningful within the aggregate. Here, we ask how the symmetries of constituent structures relate to aggregate symmetry, and how this relation determines the constraints that global symmetry imposes on transitions between local symmetry sectors. We construct a covariant local-to-global representation from framed local symmetry data and show that its reconstruction map intertwines with a global quantum representation. By identifying which global symmetry sectors overlap each local symmetry sector, we resolve symmetry-enforced dynamical exclusions into site-resolved pathways. Through Frobenius reciprocity, these exclusions can be determined from standard character tables of the local and global symmetry groups, with the character values in the inner product paired according to the relative positions and orientations of local structures within the aggregate. Although motivated by molecular aggregates, the construction is formulated for arbitrary geometries modeled by a homogeneous space of an ambient transformation group.

AI.tldr: 该文构造了从"标架局域对称数据"到全局对称表示的协变局域—全局表示，并利用Frobenius互反律，通过配对的局域/全局特征标内积，把对称性强制的跃迁禁戒分解为按位点分辨的路径。
AI.motivation: 把聚集体分解为单体、化学基团、motif等局域结构单元是常规做法，但隐含"局域结构在聚集体中仍有意义"的假设。作者追问：构成单元自身的对称性与聚集体全局对称性之间是什么关系，以及全局对称性对局域对称扇区之间跃迁施加何种约束。
AI.method: 基于标架化（framed）的局域对称数据构造协变局域—全局表示，证明其重构映射与一个全局量子表示交织（intertwine）；通过判别哪些全局对称扇区与各局域扇区重叠，将对称性强制的动力学禁戒展开为按位点分辨的通路；再借助Frobenius互反律，由局域与全局对称群的标准特征标表直接确定这些禁戒，内积中的特征标值按局域结构在聚集体中的相对位置与取向配对。框架对可由环境变换群齐性空间建模的任意几何成立。
AI.result: 建立了局域对称扇区到全局对称扇区的显式对应（通过重叠关系与交织映射），并给出可计算的禁戒判据：仅用标准特征标表、按相对位置与取向配对特征标值即可得到位点分辨的跃迁禁戒通路。
AI.conclusion: 局域结构的对称性在聚集体中并非简单保持，而是通过全局对称性与局域对称群之间的表示论关系（重叠扇区与Frobenius互反）被约束；所得方法适用于任意齐性空间几何下的聚合体系。

title: Dynamics and transport in LiF using classical and machine learned interatomic potentials
summary: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride, comparing the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials with machine-learnt interatomic potentials - the MACE-MP-0b3 (small) foundation model potential, and a fine-tuned version thereof. We find that the MACE-MP-0b3, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental shear viscosity across the liquid state comparable with polarisable potentials despite not itself being polarisable. Previous viscosities computed using classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature. Prompted by this we compare the melting points of these potentials. We find that the machine-learnt potentials address the significant underestimation of the melting point of the classical potentials, though the refined potential and the foundation model differ significantly between themselves. We probe the microscopic structure and dynamics of each model to further elucidate the considerable change in viscosity between classical and machine-learnt potentials. We find that, despite their lower melting temperature, classical potentials produce considerably stiffer, higher frequency, single-particle and collective charge-transport dynamics on account of their fixed charges. However, in the long-wavelength limit, the many-body machine-learnt potentials feature more elastic collective motion that governs the diffusion of momentum and is therefore responsible for the enhanced shear viscosity.

AI.tldr: 对熔融LiF进行分子动力学模拟，比较经典Buckingham/Born-Huggins-Mayer势与MACE-MP-0b3基础模型势及其微调版本；机器学习势能准确再现实验剪切黏度和熔点，经典势因固定电荷导致动力学过"硬"而低估黏度。
AI.motivation: 经典Buckingham与Born-Huggins-Mayer势计算的熔融LiF剪切黏度被显著低估，此前归因于熔点被压低；需用非极化的机器学习势检验这一解释并厘清黏度偏差的微观机制。
AI.method: 分子动力学模拟熔融LiF，对比经典Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer势与MACE-MP-0b3（small）基础模型势及其微调版本，计算剪切黏度、熔点，并分析微观结构、单粒子与集体电荷输运动力学及长波极限下的集体运动。
AI.result: MACE-MP-0b3开箱即用即可在整个液态区间准确再现实验剪切黏度，与可极化势相当，尽管其本身不可极化；机器学习势纠正了经典势对熔点的显著低估，但微调势与基础模型之间差异明显；经典势因固定电荷产生更"硬"、更高频的单粒子与集体电荷输运动力学，而机器学习多体势在长波极限下表现出更具弹性的集体运动，主导动量扩散，从而给出更高的剪切黏度。
AI.conclusion: 黏度偏差并非仅由熔点低估所致；多体机器学习势在长波极限下更弹性的集体动量输运是剪切黏度提升的关键，固定电荷经典势无法描述该效应。

title: Probing the real-time decoding accuracy bounds in trapped ion architectures
summary: Fault tolerant quantum computers will rely on real-time decoders that process syndromes faster than the QEC cycle duration. The millisecond cycle times offered by trapped ion platforms relax low-latency decoding demands, but simulations and experiments have not yet exploited this time budget to reach maximum logical error suppression. We show how a hybrid sliding window decoding scheme composed of a lower-accuracy and a higher-accuracy decoder can yield substantially improved logical error rates, while preserving low latency. All windows are handled by the lower-accuracy decoder, with some windows being infrequently switched to the higher-accuracy decoder. We extract soft-output information from the lower-accuracy decoder efficiently for any QLDPC code, which allows us to identify decoding windows of low confidence. We simulate memory experiments of bivariate bicycle (BB) codes, using trapped-ion informed noise models. Depending on the physical error rate and BB code, we find up to 3-4 orders of magnitude logical error rate reduction compared to the $\texttt{BP-LSD}$ decoder, and up to 2-3 orders of magnitude lower logical error rate compared to the $\texttt{Beamsearch}$ decoder. By leveraging available classical processing time, our decoding protocol significantly boosts decoding accuracy, ultimately reducing the demands on increasing code size.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合滑动窗口解码方案，由低精度与高精度解码器组成，利用低精度解码器的软输出信息识别低置信度窗口并罕见地切换到高精度解码器，在保持低延迟的同时将逻辑错误率降低最多3-4个数量级。
AI.motivation: 囚禁离子平台的毫秒级QEC周期时延要求宽松，但已有模拟与实验尚未利用这一时间预算来实现最大逻辑错误抑制；同时需在低延迟约束下提升解码精度以减轻对码距/码尺寸增长的需求。
AI.method: 设计混合滑动窗口解码：所有窗口默认由低精度解码器处理，并从中高效提取适用于任意QLDPC码的软输出信息，据此识别低置信度窗口，仅对这些窗口不频繁地切换到高精度解码器；采用囚禁离子噪声模型对bivariate bicycle (BB)码进行存储实验模拟。
AI.result: 相较BP-LSD解码器逻辑错误率降低最多3-4个数量级，相较Beamsearch解码器降低最多2-3个数量级，且保持低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用可用的经典处理时间，该解码协议显著提升解码精度，最终降低对增大码尺寸的需求。

title: Ultrafast imprinting of fused ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic skyrmions
summary: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions are promising topologically protected entities for robust storage and THz transport of information. Their generation has so far relied on slow techniques or on specific magnetic structures, which limit their integration into spintronic devices. Here, we demonstrate the imprinting of antiferromagnetic skyrmions within a few picoseconds in a coupled ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic bilayer with a thermal laser pulse. We identify a threshold energy required to initiate the fused skyrmion phase and show that this can be modulated by a magnetic field, enabling deterministic nucleation of antiferromagnetic skyrmions. Compared to conventional slow field-cooling processes to control antiferromagnets we show that laser-induced skyrmion imprinting can be orders of magnitude faster and provides an experimentally feasible route towards ultrafast creation and manipulation of antiferromagnetic skyrmions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用热激光脉冲在铁磁/反铁磁耦合双层中于数皮秒内压印反铁磁斯格明子，并揭示存在成核阈值能量、可由外磁场调制以实现确定性成核。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁斯格明子具有拓扑保护性，适合稳健存储与太赫兹信息传输，但现有生成手段依赖缓慢技术或特定磁结构，难以集成到自旋电子器件中。
AI.method: 在铁磁/反铁磁耦合双层结构中施加热激光脉冲，实现反铁磁斯格明子的压印；测定触发"融合斯格明子相"所需的阈值能量，并施加外磁场调节该阈值以实现确定性成核；与传统慢速场冷工艺进行对比。
AI.result: 确定存在启动融合斯格明子相的阈值能量；该阈值可由磁场调制，从而实现反铁磁斯格明子的确定性成核；压印过程较场冷过程快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 激光诱导斯格明子压印为反铁磁斯格明子的超快产生与操控提供了实验可行的途径，明显优于传统慢速场冷方法。

title: Simplifying models of noisy stabilizer QEC on leakage qubits by Pauli twirling
summary: The growing capabilities of quantum error-correction (QEC) experiments make it increasingly important to develop methods that predict or assess logical performance over many QEC cycles. Prior work has shown that a stabilizer QEC cycle subject to Pauli-stochastic noise can be modeled by a classical Markov process over syndrome states, with a logical Pauli channel attached to each syndrome transition. Here, we extend this framework to systems in which physical qubits are subject to leakage. We first develop the theory of leakage-dephased Pauli twirling and show that twirled processes can be expressed in terms of Pauli maps on the computational subspace, conditioned on transitions between leakage patterns. We apply this theory to noisy stabilizer QEC with leakage, demonstrating that a QEC cycle with leakage can be modeled by a classical Markov process over the joint syndrome and leakage patterns, with a logical Pauli channel attached to each joint transition. Finally, we derive a transfer-matrix description of repeated QEC cycles and an exact transfer-matrix expression for the success probability of a QEC memory experiment. This framework connects leaky error models of the individual components of the QEC cycle to many-cycle logical performance and provides a foundation for logical characterization and benchmarking methods that can account for leakage.

AI.tldr: 该文将含泄漏噪声的稳定子量子纠错周期建模为联合"综合征-泄漏模式"上的经典马尔可夫过程，每个联合跃迁附带逻辑Pauli信道，并给出重复纠错周期的转移矩阵描述与记忆实验成功率的精确表达式。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错实验能力提升，需要能预测/评估多周期逻辑性能的方法。已有工作证明Pauli随机噪声下的稳定子纠错周期可用综合征态上的经典马尔可夫过程建模，但未涵盖物理量子比特的泄漏（leakage）噪声，需要将该框架推广到含泄漏系统。
AI.method: 1) 建立"泄漏退相位Pauli twirling"理论，证明twirl后的过程可表示为计算子空间上的Pauli映射，并以泄漏模式间跃迁为条件；2) 将该理论应用于含泄漏的含噪稳定子QEC，证明一个含泄漏的纠错周期可由联合综合征与泄漏模式上的经典马尔可夫过程建模，每个联合跃迁附带一个逻辑Pauli信道；3) 推导重复纠错周期的转移矩阵描述，并给出QEC记忆实验成功率的精确转移矩阵表达式。
AI.result: 得到含泄漏稳定子QEC周期的经典马尔可夫链表示（状态为综合征与泄漏模式的联合），以及重复周期的转移矩阵形式化和记忆实验成功率的精确转移矩阵公式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把纠错周期各组件级的泄漏错误模型与多周期逻辑性能联系起来，为能够处理泄漏的逻辑表征与基准测试方法奠定基础。

title: Optical characterization of Fermi polarons in monolayer MoSe$_2$ encapsulated in amorphous silicon nitride
summary: Amorphous silicon nitride is the leading low-loss, CMOS-compatible platform for wafer-scale integrated photonics. Encapsulating transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers within this platform offers a promising route towards scalable TMD-photonic circuits. Yet the effect of this amorphous dielectric on the optical response of the monolayer remains poorly understood. Here, we compare monolayer MoSe$_2$ encapsulated in amorphous silicon nitride with a hexagonal boron nitride-encapsulated reference, using differential reflectivity and photoluminescence. Whereas the reference is dominated by the neutral exciton, the nitride-encapsulated monolayer shows attractive and repulsive polaron resonances separated by ${\sim}31$~meV, with emission dominated by the attractive branch. A quantitative comparison of temperature-dependent reflectance with a microscopic finite-temperature Fermi-polaron theory shows that the nitride induces substantial electron doping in the monolayer, with an electron density of $(0.8$--$0.9)\times10^{12}$~cm$^{-2}$. Using the extracted density and trion binding energy as the only input parameters, the theory reproduces the photoluminescence spectra up to ${\sim}80$ K in excellent quantitative agreement with experiments, thus corroborating the Fermi-polaron description of the observed excitonic response.

title: Complexity and precision in quantum associative retrieval
summary: We show that efficient and high-precision quantum associative retrieval is possible with an exponential complexity advantage with respect to the classical brute force approach and with a polynomial capacity advantage with respect to classical neural network implementations for any number of patterns scaling polynomially in the number of qubits. Both classical neural and quantum associative memories store the patterns in a Hamiltonian; in the classical case the dynamics is irreversible relaxation toward attractors, in the quantum case it is unitary transformations generating an effective thermal distribution, followed by a measurement.

AI.tldr: 该文证明量子联想检索可实现相对于经典暴力搜索的指数级复杂度优势和相对于经典神经网络的多项式容量优势，前提是模式数随量子比特数多项式增长。
